description: Plays sixteen loaded WAV files, each fired by one channel of a polyphonic trigger input, and mixes them to one stereo pair

inputs.text: A polyphonic trigger input, one channel per sample: a rising edge on channel 1 plays the first sample, channel 2 the second, and so on through all sixteen

outputs.text: The left channel of all sixteen players added together
The right channel of all sixteen players added together

notes: nothing plays until WAV files are loaded from the right-click menu, either one at a time or sixteen at once from a folder
menu: Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Load individual samples — the sixteen numbered items under this label each open a file browser for that sample slot, and each prints the filename it holds
Load first 16 WAV files from a folder — opens a folder browser and puts that folder's first sixteen WAV files into the sixteen slots in name order
